explanation: Patrick was born in Roman Britain. By his own account, raiders carried him to Ireland as a teenager; he escaped, then later returned as a missionary.

claims.text: Saint Patrick is the patron saint of Ireland.
The patron saints of Scotland, Wales and England are Andrew, David and George, not Patrick.
Patrick was born in Roman Britain.
In his Confessio, Patrick writes that Irish raiders captured him when he was about 16 years old.
Patrick escaped from captivity and later returned to Ireland as a missionary.
